latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pre-seed-fundraising-coach.

- Provides end-to-end coaching for first-time and early-stage founders raising a pre-seed or seed round outside accelerators.
- Guides through four phases: deciding whether to raise, building an investor pipeline, running an effective process, and post-close management.
- Distinct from accelerator and pitch deck coaching; focuses on round structure, networking strategy, investor pipeline, and negotiation.
- Includes a detailed diagnostic questionnaire to tailor guidance.
- Covers round mechanics: SAFE, pre/post-money, convertible notes, cap table, dilution math, and typical round sizes.
- Helps founders avoid common fundraising mistakes and prepare for a successful next round.
